; Commissioning template. Motion rates are initial settings; hardware calibration and HAL are required.

KINEMATICS = trivkins coordinates=XYZ

[TRAJ]
COORDINATES = XYZ
LINEAR_UNITS = mm
ANGULAR_UNITS = degree

[DISPLAY]

[BETTERCNC_HOMING]

MOTOR_DIRECTIONS_VERIFIED = NO

[AXIS_X]
MAX_VELOCITY = 0.5
MAX_ACCELERATION = 5

[JOINT_0]
TYPE = LINEAR
MAX_VELOCITY = 0.5
MAX_ACCELERATION = 5

STEP_SCALE = 320
[AXIS_Y]
MAX_VELOCITY = 0.5
MAX_ACCELERATION = 5

[JOINT_1]
TYPE = LINEAR
MAX_VELOCITY = 0.5
MAX_ACCELERATION = 5

STEP_SCALE = 320
[AXIS_Z]
MAX_VELOCITY = 0.5
MAX_ACCELERATION = 5

[JOINT_2]
TYPE = LINEAR
MAX_VELOCITY = 0.5
MAX_ACCELERATION = 5
STEP_SCALE = 320

axis-5.ini:
# BC cradle commissioning preset. Joint rates are initial settings.
# Zhulong V2 STEP/DIR connectors: X=AXIS 0 (stepgen.00),
# Y=AXIS 1 (stepgen.01), Z=AXIS 2 (stepgen.02).
[KINS]
JOINTS = 5
KINEMATICS = trivkins coordinates=XYZBC

[TRAJ]
COORDINATES = XYZBC
LINEAR_UNITS = mm
ANGULAR_UNITS = degree
# Base platform catalog ceiling of 3500 mm/min, expressed in mm/s.
MAX_LINEAR_VELOCITY = 58.333333

[DISPLAY]
PROGRAM_PREFIX = /var/lib/betterlinuxcnc/programs
DISPLAY = betterlinuxcnc
GEOMETRY = XYZBC

[SPINDLE_0]
MAX_FORWARD_VELOCITY = 24000

# Manufacturer specifications for the 2200 W base machine before cradle installation.
# The catalog gives a machining envelope, not measured travel or home positions.
# For this mounting, X runs along the table length and Y across its width.
[BETTERCNC_PLATFORM]
MACHINING_WIDTH_MM = 400
MACHINING_LENGTH_MM = 600
MACHINING_DEPTH_MM = 90
MATERIAL_CLEARANCE_MM = 130
TABLE_WIDTH_MM = 480
TABLE_LENGTH_MM = 800
REPEATABILITY_MM = 0.01
SPINDLE_POWER_W = 2200
SPINDLE_COOLING = WATER
STEPPER_MOTOR = 57-3A
BALL_SCREW = 1605
SUPPLY_VOLTAGE_AC_V = 220
SUPPLY_FREQUENCY_HZ = 50
MACHINE_WIDTH_MM = 650
MACHINE_LENGTH_MM = 850
MACHINE_HEIGHT_MM = 510
APPROX_MACHINE_MASS_KG = 68

# ABC-Table-BG.step reference dimensions from the mounting feet, without risers.
# The model's tilt shaft is assumed parallel to machine Y for this BC mounting.
[BETTERCNC_CRADLE_REFERENCE]
TILT_PIVOT_HEIGHT_MM = 40
LEVEL_PLATTER_FACE_HEIGHT_MM = 65
PLATTER_FACE_OUTER_RADIUS_MM = 37
# Peak of the bare clamping face over all C orientations and the requested B range.
# 40 + hypot(65 - 40, 37) at about 56 degrees of tilt.
PEAK_PLATTER_FACE_HEIGHT_MM = 84.65
FIXED_END_SUPPORT_HEIGHT_MM = 90

[BETTERCNC_HOMING]
# bc-xyz-limits.hal shares the negative limits with the home inputs.
# On this BC cradle, HostMot2 reads X=GPIO020, Y=GPIO021, Z=GPIO022 high when pressed.
# Reported switch-to-hard-stop clearance is 5-8 mm. Axis travel is unmeasured.
PROFILE = zhulong-v2
SWITCH_INPUTS_VERIFIED = YES
MOTOR_MAPPING_VERIFIED = NO
MOTOR_DIRECTIONS_VERIFIED = NO

# Provisional machine-coordinate ranges for the uncommissioned cradle.
# X/Y use the low end as zero, Z the upper end, and B/C the neutral orientation.
# XYZ estimates use the base machine's catalog machining envelope in mm.
# Rotary estimates are in degrees. Homing uses separate measurements.
[AXIS_X]
ESTIMATED_TRAVEL = 600
MIN_LIMIT = 0
MAX_LIMIT = 580
MAX_VELOCITY = 5
MAX_ACCELERATION = 50

[JOINT_0]
TYPE = LINEAR
# Vendor reference only; physical scaling is pending.
STEP_SCALE = 200
MIN_LIMIT = 0
MAX_LIMIT = 580
MAX_VELOCITY = 5
MAX_ACCELERATION = 50

[AXIS_Y]
ESTIMATED_TRAVEL = 400
MIN_LIMIT = 0
MAX_LIMIT = 380
MAX_VELOCITY = 5
MAX_ACCELERATION = 50

[JOINT_1]
TYPE = LINEAR
# Vendor reference only; physical scaling is pending.
STEP_SCALE = 200
MIN_LIMIT = 0
MAX_LIMIT = 380
MAX_VELOCITY = 5
MAX_ACCELERATION = 50

[AXIS_Z]
# Commissioning draft with machine zero at the upper end. Cradle heights are
# relative to its feet and cannot define the spindle slide's machine limits.
ESTIMATED_TRAVEL = 90
MIN_LIMIT = -50
MAX_LIMIT = 0
MAX_VELOCITY = 5
MAX_ACCELERATION = 50

[JOINT_2]
TYPE = LINEAR
# Vendor reference only; physical scaling is pending.
STEP_SCALE = 200
MIN_LIMIT = -50
MAX_LIMIT = 0
MAX_VELOCITY = 5
MAX_ACCELERATION = 50

[AXIS_B]
ESTIMATED_TRAVEL = 120
MIN_LIMIT = -60
MAX_LIMIT = 60
MAX_VELOCITY = 1
MAX_ACCELERATION = 2

[JOINT_3]
TYPE = ANGULAR
MIN_LIMIT = -60
MAX_LIMIT = 60
MAX_VELOCITY = 1
MAX_ACCELERATION = 2

[AXIS_C]
ESTIMATED_TRAVEL = 360
MIN_LIMIT = -180
MAX_LIMIT = 180
MAX_VELOCITY = 1
MAX_ACCELERATION = 2

[JOINT_4]
TYPE = ANGULAR
MIN_LIMIT = -180
MAX_LIMIT = 180
MAX_VELOCITY = 1
MAX_ACCELERATION = 2

[EMC]
VERSION = 1.1
MACHINE = Zhulong V2 XYZBC - input commissioning

[TASK]
TASK = milltask
CYCLE_TIME = 0.010

[RS274NGC]
PARAMETER_FILE = /var/lib/betterlinuxcnc/machine/linuxcnc.var
RS274NGC_STARTUP_CODE = G21 G40 G90 G94 G97

[EMCMOT]
EMCMOT = motmod
HOMEMOD = zhulong_homing
SERVO_PERIOD = 1000000
COMM_TIMEOUT = 1.0

[EMCIO]
EMCIO = io
CYCLE_TIME = 0.100
TOOL_TABLE = /var/lib/betterlinuxcnc/machine/tool.tbl

[HAL]
HALFILE = bc-inputs.hal
HALFILE = bc-xyz-limits.hal
bc-inputs.hal:
# Input commissioning on the BC cradle. The Mesa terminals are inputs.
loadrt [KINS]KINEMATICS
loadrt [EMCMOT]EMCMOT servo_period_nsec=[EMCMOT]SERVO_PERIOD num_joints=[KINS]JOINTS
loadrt hostmot2
loadrt hm2_eth board_ip="10.10.10.10" config="num_stepgens=0 num_pwmgens=0 num_encoders=0 sserial_port_0=xxxxxxxx num_dplls=0 num_leds=0"

# Keep the controller in external E-stop until a drive installation is commissioned.
setp iocontrol.0.emc-enable-in false
setp motion.enable false
setp motion.homing-inhibit true
setp motion.jog-inhibit true

addf hm2_7i92.0.read servo-thread
addf motion-command-handler servo-thread
addf motion-controller servo-thread
addf hm2_7i92.0.write servo-thread
bc-xyz-limits.hal:
# Zhulong V2 BC cradle. Load after motion and the HostMot2 Ethernet driver.
# HostMot2 reads each switch as 1 when pressed and 0 when released.
# Each switch is both the negative limit and the home input.
# This fragment owns the three home input connections. Omit the vendor HAL's
# separate x-home-sw, y-home-sw and z-home-sw assignments when composing it.
net x-neg-limit hm2_7i92.0.gpio.020.in => joint.0.neg-lim-sw-in joint.0.home-sw-in
net y-neg-limit hm2_7i92.0.gpio.021.in => joint.1.neg-lim-sw-in joint.1.home-sw-in
net z-neg-limit hm2_7i92.0.gpio.022.in => joint.2.neg-lim-sw-in joint.2.home-sw-in
